question.problem: Given the transformation $T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}x+2y \\ y-x+6z \\ 8z-x+3y\end{aligned}],$ find its rank.
question.worked_solution:
First, the standard matrix of $T$ is given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 6 \\ -1 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}].
$$

Recall that $\text{rank}(T)=\text{dim}(\text{Im}(T))=\text{rank}(T).$ 

So, we need to find the rank of the matrix $T.$ We reduce $T$ to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}T & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 6 \\ -1 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 5 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-\frac{5}{3}){R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, since $T$ has $3$ pivot columns, we have that 

$$
\text{rank}(T)=\text{rank}(T)=3.
$$
